quests.instruction: Mia pours cereal and orange juice at seven o'clock, right before the school bus comes. What time is it?
quests.question: 7:00 AM
quests.hint: Think about what usually happens right before school starts.
quests.explanation: Since the school bus is coming soon, seven o'clock must be in the morning: 7:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Most school buses pick children up in the early morning hours.

quests.instruction: The whole class lines up for lunch at twelve o'clock. What time is it?
quests.question: 12:00 PM
quests.hint: This hour has a special daytime nickname.
quests.explanation: Twelve o'clock in the daytime is noon, written as 12:00 PM.
quests.funFact: 12:00 PM and 12:00 AM are the only hours that don't repeat like the others.

quests.instruction: Grandpa turns off the porch light at nine o'clock before bed. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 PM
quests.hint: Porch lights usually get turned off once it's dark outside.
quests.explanation: Since it's bedtime and dark outside, nine o'clock here is at night: 9:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Turning off outdoor lights at night helps everyone sleep better.

quests.instruction: A rooster crows loudly at six o'clock, waking the whole farm. What time is it?
quests.question: 6:00 AM
quests.hint: Roosters are famous for greeting one particular part of the day.
quests.explanation: Roosters crow to greet the sunrise, so six o'clock here is 6:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Roosters are known for crowing right as the sun comes up.

quests.instruction: Backpacks come off the hooks at three o'clock as the final bell rings. What time is it?
quests.question: 3:00 PM
quests.hint: Think about when the school day usually comes to a close.
quests.explanation: Since the final school bell is ringing, three o'clock here is in the afternoon: 3:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Final school bells usually ring in the middle of the afternoon.

quests.instruction: The whole neighborhood is dark and silent by ten o'clock. What time is it?
quests.question: 10:00 PM
quests.hint: A dark, quiet neighborhood is a clue about which part of the day.
quests.explanation: A dark, quiet neighborhood means ten o'clock here is late at night: 10:00 PM.
quests.funFact: By 10:00 PM, most neighborhoods have gone quiet for the night.

quests.instruction: Liam brushes his teeth right after breakfast at eight o'clock. What time is it?
quests.question: 8:00 AM
quests.hint: Breakfast is the meal that starts the day.
quests.explanation: Since this happens right after breakfast, eight o'clock here is in the morning: 8:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Brushing teeth after breakfast helps keep smiles healthy all day.

quests.instruction: The class settles down for quiet reading at one o'clock, right after lunch trays are cleared. What time is it?
quests.question: 1:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens soon after the midday meal.
quests.explanation: Since lunch trays were just cleared, one o'clock here is in the afternoon: 1:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Quiet reading time often follows lunch in many classrooms.

quests.instruction: Pajamas go on at eight o'clock while the stars begin to twinkle outside. What time is it?
quests.question: 8:00 PM
quests.hint: Stars only twinkle during one part of the day.
quests.explanation: Since stars are twinkling outside, eight o'clock here is at night: 8:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Stars become visible once the sky grows dark in the evening.

quests.instruction: The morning announcements play over the speaker at nine o'clock. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 AM
quests.hint: This word right in the sentence is a strong clue.
quests.explanation: The sentence says "morning announcements," so nine o'clock here is 9:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Many schools share morning announcements right as the day begins.

quests.instruction: Swings creak back and forth at the park at four o'clock, right after school lets out. What time is it?
quests.question: 4:00 PM
quests.hint: Think about when children usually head to the park after class.
quests.explanation: Since school just let out, four o'clock here is in the afternoon: 4:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Parks often fill up with children in the afternoon after school.

quests.instruction: Even the grown-ups are yawning and heading to bed at eleven o'clock. What time is it?
quests.question: 11:00 PM
quests.hint: Grown-ups don't usually go to bed during the daytime.
quests.explanation: Since even the grown-ups are going to bed, eleven o'clock here is at night: 11:00 PM.
quests.funFact: 11:00 PM is late enough that most households have settled down.

quests.instruction: The family gathers around a warm dinner at seven o'clock. What time is it?
quests.question: 7:00 PM
quests.hint: Think about when dinner usually happens, not breakfast.
quests.explanation: Since this is dinner, not breakfast, seven o'clock here is in the evening: 7:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Many families share dinner together in the early evening.

quests.instruction: A healthy snack is handed out at ten o'clock, right in between two lessons. What time is it?
quests.question: 10:00 AM
quests.hint: This happens while school is still going on for the day.
quests.explanation: Since two lessons are still happening, ten o'clock here is in the morning: 10:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Mid-morning snacks help children stay focused in class.

quests.instruction: Rest mats are rolled out at two o'clock, not long after the lunch bell. What time is it?
quests.question: 2:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens after the midday meal, not before it.
quests.explanation: Since the lunch bell already rang, two o'clock here is in the afternoon: 2:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Quiet rest time often happens in the early afternoon at school.

quests.instruction: The sky glows orange and pink at six o'clock as the sun begins to set. What time is it?
quests.question: 6:00 PM
quests.hint: Sunsets happen at one particular part of the day.
quests.explanation: Since the sun is setting, six o'clock here is in the evening: 6:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Sunsets often paint the sky orange and pink in the evening.

quests.instruction: Paintbrushes come out for art class at eleven o'clock, just before lunch. What time is it?
quests.question: 11:00 AM
quests.hint: This happens shortly before the midday meal.
quests.explanation: Since lunch is coming up soon, eleven o'clock here is in the morning: 11:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Art class often happens in the late morning, right before lunch.

quests.instruction: Homework gets packed away at five o'clock as dinner smells fill the kitchen. What time is it?
quests.question: 5:00 PM
quests.hint: Dinner smells usually mean the afternoon is turning into evening.
quests.explanation: Since dinner is cooking, five o'clock here is in the late afternoon: 5:00 PM.
quests.funFact: 5:00 PM is a common time for homework to wrap up before dinner.

quests.instruction: Shoes are laced up at seven o'clock while the sun is still low in the sky. What time is it?
quests.question: 7:00 AM
quests.hint: A low sun in the sky can mean sunrise, not sunset.
quests.explanation: Since the sun is still low from rising, seven o'clock here is in the morning: 7:00 AM.
quests.funFact: The sun sits low in the sky both at sunrise and sunset, so context matters!

quests.instruction: Shadows shrink to their shortest at twelve o'clock on a sunny day. What time is it?
quests.question: 12:00 PM
quests.hint: Short shadows happen when the sun is at its very highest.
quests.explanation: Shadows are shortest when the sun is highest, at noon: 12:00 PM.
quests.funFact: At solar noon, your shadow becomes the shortest it will be all day.

quests.instruction: A soft lullaby plays at nine o'clock as the room grows dark. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 PM
quests.hint: Lullabies are usually sung to help someone fall asleep.
quests.explanation: Since the room is dark and a lullaby is playing, nine o'clock here is at night: 9:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Soft music at night can help children drift off to sleep.

quests.instruction: The crossing guard waves at eight o'clock as children walk into school. What time is it?
quests.question: 8:00 AM
quests.hint: Think about when children usually arrive at school.
quests.explanation: Since children are arriving at school, eight o'clock here is in the morning: 8:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Crossing guards often help children cross safely in the morning.

quests.instruction: A juice box is opened at three o'clock, right when the afternoon snack cart rolls by. What time is it?
quests.question: 3:00 PM
quests.hint: This snack comes well after lunch, not before it.
quests.explanation: Since this is an afternoon snack after lunch, three o'clock here is 3:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Afternoon snacks are a common treat between lunch and dinner.

quests.instruction: A nightlight glows softly at ten o'clock in an otherwise dark room. What time is it?
quests.question: 10:00 PM
quests.hint: Nightlights are used once it's dark for sleeping.
quests.explanation: Since the room is dark for sleep, ten o'clock here is at night: 10:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Nightlights help some children feel cozy and safe while sleeping.

quests.instruction: Backpacks are hung up at nine o'clock as the first lesson begins. What time is it?
quests.question: 9:00 AM
quests.hint: This is the very start of the school day.
quests.explanation: Since the first lesson is just beginning, nine o'clock here is in the morning: 9:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Many schools begin their first lesson around nine in the morning.

quests.instruction: Forks click against plates at six o'clock as the family shares dinner. What time is it?
quests.question: 6:00 PM
quests.hint: Think about which meal usually happens at this hour.
quests.explanation: Since the family is sharing dinner, six o'clock here is in the evening: 6:00 PM.
quests.funFact: 6:00 PM is a popular hour for families to eat dinner together.

quests.instruction: A recess whistle blows at one o'clock, right after the lunch line clears. What time is it?
quests.question: 1:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens once lunch has already finished.
quests.explanation: Since lunch has already finished, one o'clock here is in the afternoon: 1:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Some schools schedule a short recess right after lunch.

quests.instruction: Bubbles fill the tub at seven o'clock as bath time begins. What time is it?
quests.question: 7:00 PM
quests.hint: Baths before bed usually happen in the evening.
quests.explanation: Since this bath is happening before bed, seven o'clock here is in the evening: 7:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Warm evening baths can help children feel calm before sleep.

quests.instruction: Library books are checked out at ten o'clock during a morning class visit. What time is it?
quests.question: 10:00 AM
quests.hint: This visit happens while morning classes are still going.
quests.explanation: Since morning classes are still happening, ten o'clock here is 10:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Many schools schedule library visits during morning class time.

quests.instruction: A kite dips and soars at four o'clock, right after the school bell rings. What time is it?
quests.question: 4:00 PM
quests.hint: This happens once the school day has already ended.
quests.explanation: Since the school bell already rang for the day, four o'clock here is 4:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Afternoons after school are a popular time for flying kites.
